messages:
zoe: Mango discovered the one perfect rectangle of sunlight and will not be moved. pic: https://i.imgur.com/MangoSun1.jpg :sun_with_face:
ryan: that is a certified loaf. also Mango's ear tilt = CEO energy :sunglasses:
kim: Mango photobombed my meeting yesterday. blame the light, not the cat. zoom screenshot incoming :rofl:
sam: can confirm -- Mango's zoom cameo increased team's morale by 73% (unofficial metric). also brought snacks.
zoe: updated evidence: Mango dragged my notebook into the sun and used it as a pillow. RIP notes. pic: https://i.imgur.com/MangoSun2.jpg
ryan: question: is Mango allowed to be on keyboards? do we need a policy? :thinking_face:
kim: official policy: approved on the condition Mango approves of the meeting. veto power is Mango's.
ops-bot: reaction logged :heart: from 3 users. Reminder: please secure hot beverages around cats.
sam: poll time: should we have an office "Sunbeam Spot" reserved for Mango during in-person days? reply yes/no
zoe: yes from me. Mango needs his throne.
ryan: yes. I will bring a tiny cushion.
kim: no, i will fight you for it (kidding, yes).
zoe: small audio: faint purr roar uploaded, will add to playlist "Mango ASMR"
sam: also pro tip: Mango will only accept carrots as bribes (???).
ryan: i made an extremely accurate caption: "Occupied: please leave a message after the nap"
zoe: final pic: Mango using my phone as a coaster. guess who is late replying to DMs now. :sweat_smile: https://i.imgur.com/MangoSun3.jpg
